{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Jamaica|Jamaican cuisine]]
__NOTOC__
==Ingredients==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground [[Cookbook:Allspice|allspice]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* ½ tsp ground [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
* 1 tsp ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* ¼ tsp freshly-grated [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]]
* ½ tbsp dried [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* 2 tbsp dehydrated [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] peel
* 3 tbsp dark [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]
* 4 boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breasts]]
* ¼ cup brown [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine rum and mustard, and rub all over chicken.
#Combine remaining ingredients and rub all over chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, but it is better to [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinate]] overnight.
#Place chicken on a greased, preheated charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]]. Cook, turning constantly until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove and let rest for 10 minutes.
#Serve.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* The spices always included allspice because the berries of the pimento tree are the source of allspice.
* When cooking the meat, barbecue is by far the best technique—failing that, oven bake. [[Cookbook:Basting|Basting]] with beer is worth trying.
* Serve with rice and peas.

==Warnings==

* See the [[Cookbook:Chili Pepper#Precautions|chili pepper]] warnings.
